ei.subject: 2025년 10월 고1 모의고사
ei.title: 30번 — Gen Z의 가치 기반 금융 결정

fullPassage: While convenience and technology are crucial, they are not the only factors driving Gen Z's financial decisions. This generation is incredibly values-driven, and they want to bank with institutions that match their personal beliefs and values. Transparency is vital. Gen Z is skeptical of large corporations and institutions that lack accountability. They have grown up in a world where information is freely available, and they expect complete transparency from the brands they support. Banks, for example, must clearly communicate fees, terms, and conditions, as well as how they handle customers' data. Moreover, ethical banking practices are more important than ever. Gen Z cares about the environment, social justice, and the ethical implications of their financial decisions. They are interested in sustainable investing, supporting businesses that match their values, and ensuring that their money is not being used to fund beneficial practices. Banks that offer socially responsible investment opportunities and are committed to environmental sustainability will attract Gen Z's attention.

questions.passage: This generation is incredibly values-driven, and they want to bank with institutions that ①<u>match</u> their personal beliefs. Transparency is ②<u>vitally</u>. Gen Z is skeptical of large corporations that ③<u>lack</u> accountability. They expect complete transparency from the brands they ④<u>support</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①일치하다 ②필수적으로(→vital) ③부족하다 ④지지하다
det.analysis:
❌ ② vitally → vital: is 뒤에 보어로 형용사 필요. is vital(○) / is vitally(×)
✅ ① match: 동사 정상
✅ ③ lack: 동사 정상
✅ ④ support: 동사 정상
det.tip: be + 형용사: is vital(○) / is vitally(×)

questions.passage: They have ①<u>grown</u> up in a world where information is ②<u>free</u> available. They expect complete transparency from the brands they support. Banks must ③<u>clearly</u> communicate fees, terms, and conditions. Ethical banking practices are more ④<u>important</u> than ever.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①자란 ②자유롭게(→freely) ③명확히 ④중요한
det.analysis:
❌ ② free → freely: 형용사 available을 수식하는 부사 필요. freely available(○) / free available(×)
✅ ① grown: have grown up 현재완료 정상
✅ ③ clearly: 부사로 communicate 수식 정상
✅ ④ important: 형용사 보어 정상
det.tip: 부사 + 형용사: freely available(○). free는 형용사

questions.passage: While convenience and technology are crucial, they are not the only factors ①<u>driving</u> Gen Z's financial decisions. Gen Z is skeptical of large corporations that lack ②<u>accountability</u>. They are interested in sustainable investing, ③<u>supporting</u> businesses that match their values, and ④<u>ensure</u> that their money is not being used to fund harmful practices.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①이끄는 ②책임감 ③지지하는 ④보장하다(→ensuring)
det.analysis:
❌ ④ ensure → ensuring: investing, supporting과 병렬 구조. 동명사 ensuring이 와야 함
✅ ① driving: 현재분사 수식 정상
✅ ② accountability: 명사 정상
✅ ③ supporting: 동명사 병렬 정상
det.tip: 병렬 구조: investing, supporting, ensuring — 모두 동명사(-ing)

questions.passage: This generation is incredibly ①<u>values-driven</u>. Transparency is vital. Gen Z is ②<u>trusting</u> of large corporations that lack accountability. They expect complete transparency from the brands they ③<u>support</u>. Ethical banking practices are more ④<u>important</u> than ever.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 낱말 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ①가치 중심적 ②신뢰하는(→skeptical 회의적) ③지지하다 ④중요한
det.analysis:
❌ ② trusting(신뢰하는)은 skeptical(회의적)의 반의어. 책임감 없는 대기업을 '신뢰'하면 투명성 요구와 모순
✅ ①③④ 원문 일치

questions.passage: While convenience and technology are ①<u>crucial</u>, they are not the only factors driving Gen Z's financial decisions. Banks must clearly communicate fees, terms, and conditions. Gen Z cares about the environment and social justice. Banks that offer socially responsible investment opportunities and are committed to environmental sustainability will ②<u>repel</u> Gen Z's attention. They are interested in ③<u>sustainable</u> investing, supporting businesses that match their ④<u>values</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 낱말 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ①중요한 ②밀어내다(→attract 끌다) ③지속 가능한 ④가치관
det.analysis:
❌ ② repel(밀어내다)은 attract(끌다)의 반의어. 사회적 책임 은행이 Gen Z를 '밀어낸다'는 것은 논지에 모순
✅ ①③④ 원문 일치
det.tip: attract(끌다) ↔ repel(밀어내다). 윤리적 은행은 Gen Z를 유치

questions.passage: They have grown up in a world where information is freely ①<u>available</u>, and they expect complete ②<u>secrecy</u> from the brands they support. They are interested in ④<u>sustainable</u> investing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 낱말 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ①이용 가능한 ②비밀(→transparency 투명성) ③함의 ④지속 가능한
det.analysis:
❌ ② secrecy(비밀)는 transparency(투명성)의 반의어. 정보가 자유롭게 이용 가능한 세상에서 '비밀'을 기대한다는 것은 모순
✅ ①③④ 원문 일치
det.tip: transparency(투명성) ↔ secrecy(비밀). Gen Z는 투명성 요구
